IC1.IC1.1: Patient diagnosed by HRCT Core Lab with eligible heterogeneous disease distribution and at least one complete oblique fissure.

IC6.IC6.1: Stable with < 20 mg prednisone (or equivalent) qd

IC8.IC8.1: PaO2 > 45 mm Hg on room air

IC10.IC10.1: Nonsmoking for 4 months prior to initial interview and throughout screening

IC11.IC11.1: The patient agrees to all protocol required follow-up intervals.

IC12.IC12.1: The patient has no child bearing potential

IC13.IC13.1: The patient is willing and able to complete protocol required baseline assessments and procedures

EC2.EC2.1: Pleural or interstitial disease that precludes surgery.

EC3.EC3.1: Prior lung transplant, LVRS, median sternotomy, bullectomy or lobectomy.

EC6.EC6.1: History of recurrent respiratory infections (> 3 hospitalization in the last year)

EC7.EC7.1: Clinically significant (> 4 Tablespoons per day) sputum production

EC8.EC8.1: Fever, elevated white cell count, or other evidence of active infection

EC9.EC9.1: Dysrhythmia that might pose a risk during exercise or training

EC10.EC10.1: Congestive heart failure within 6 mo and LVEF < 45%

EC11.EC11.1: Evidence or history of Cor Pulmonale

EC12.EC12.1: Resting bradycardia (< 50 beats/min), frequent multifocal PVCs, complex ventricular arrhythmia, sustained SVT

EC15.EC15.1: Evidence of systemic disease or neoplasia expected to compromise survival during 5-yr period

EC16.EC16.1: Any disease or condition that interferes with completion of initial or follow-up assessments

EC17.EC17.1: Patient is currently enrolled in another clinical trial

EC18.EC18.1: Patient is unable to complete 3 minutes of unloaded peddling on cycle ergometer
